mapper.insert: insert into user_coupon (user_id, coupon_id, receive_time, status) values (#{userId}, #{couponId}, #{receiveTime}, #{status})
mapper.update: update user_coupon uc join coupon c on c.id = uc.coupon_id set uc.status = case when c.end_time < #{now} then 2 else 0 end, uc.order_id = null, uc.use_time = null where uc.order_id = #{orderId} and uc.status in (1, 3)
